messages:
mia: heads-up — PR #8321 is failing CI on the integration matrix. mac-worker shows a snapshot diff in prefix_kv_cache_snapshot_test. can't repro locally. any quick ideas? :confused:
alex: can you paste the failing log snippet? also which job in the matrix is it (mac-13, mac-14, etc)?
mia: mac-13 specifically. log excerpt: `AssertionError: snapshot mismatch at line 42 (expires_at=2026-03-17T12:34:56Z)` — full log here: https://ci.redwood.example/8321/job/56
jonas: that looks like a timestamp leak in the snapshot. we've seen that pattern before when a fixture writes current time into state. if it's nondeterministic we should either normalize in the test or update snapshot after fixing.
sam: quick triage: try running the single test with UPDATE_SNAP=1 locally to see if the snapshot update is clean. cmd: ```
UPDATE_SNAP=1 tox -e py39 -- tests/test_prefix_kv.py::test_prefix_kv_cache_snapshot
```
mia: thanks — running that now. fwiw the test passes locally without env var. when I set UPDATE_SNAP it rewrites the file and CI still fails on mac with same diff pattern.
rebecca: is the diff strictly the timestamp field? can you paste a minimal chunk of the snapshot diff?
mia: snippet: `- "expires_at": "2026-03-17T12:34:56Z"\n+ "expires_at": "2026-03-17T12:35:01Z"` — only a few seconds off.
jonas: yep, small delta. two options: 1) make the test freeze time (freezegun or fixture) around snapshot generation, or 2) sanitize timestamp in the object before snapshot assertion (replace with fixed token like <TS>).
alex: I lean towards normalizing the snapshot so we don't have to sprinkle freezegun everywhere. if we add a small helper sanitize_snapshot_timestamps(payload) that replaces iso timestamps with a placeholder before writing/reading snapshot, that should stabilize tests.
mia: I can implement sanitize in my PR — small change. question: because CI has already run, should we request a rerun after pushing the fix or push the fix and then ask for approval to merge? this PR is blocking a small release cut for infra patches.
sam: push the fix to the branch, force-push if needed, and then request rerun. tag @alex and @rebecca for quick review. if they approve we can merge and trigger the release job.
mia: pushed a patch that normalizes expires_at to `<TS>` before snapshot write. pushed as force-update. build kicked off.
ci-bot: build 8321/57 queued on mac-13 — rerun requested by mia.
ci-bot: build 8321/57 started on mac-13 (worker-42). logs: https://ci.redwood.example/8321/job/57
alex: thanks — will take a look in a few. if green i'll approve. :eyes:
rebecca: skimmed the change — looks fine to me, small and well-scoped. will give final after green. :thumbsup:
mia: build is green on mac-13 and linux. windows matrix still pending but shouldn't be impacted.
jonas: nice. once all matrix jobs are green can someone merge? i'm heads-down on infra but can click the button if needed.
alex: i'll merge once windows passes. if windows is flaky too we can do a manual merge with revert plan.
mia: thanks everyone — marking this thread resolved for now. will follow up if anything else pops up. :white_check_mark:
